dataList.place:
Haunted: Bloody Mary
鬼屋·血腥玛丽
dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Tzzzt... zzzt...
滋滋滋……滋滋滋……

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Congratulations, O brave adventurers. You have uncovered every secret of the kingdom.
恭喜各位，勇敢的探险家们。你们探明了王国的所有秘密。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
It is time I let you leave. Should you face such terrors in the world beyond, remember your bravery here and triumph over them as you have today.
希望你们在外直面恐惧的时候，也一定能勇敢地战胜恐惧……

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
And now, please give a warm welcome to the Bloodfiends of the attraction 'Haunted: Bloody Mary'. They'll be here for the "Spooky Scary Photoshoot with Bloodfiends".
接下来要为大家介绍稍后将与各位进行“与血魔共度毛骨悚然摄影时刻”的鬼屋·血腥玛丽的各位血魔。

And the narration just stops there, huh. Well, we already took care of the Bloodfiends who were supposed to show up on cue, so... yeah. Makes sense.
旁白不说话了。算了，反正他要介绍的血魔已经全都被我们处理掉了。

He would've G.U.H.
他说会直·进。

... "He would've graced us himself", she says.
……好像是说他要直接进场参与拍摄。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
What misfortune! Every clue that may have shed light on the secrets of this tragic kingdom's history has all been pulverized by the guests who passed through before you.
令人惋惜，与王国的秘密相关的线索已被先前经过的来宾们尽数摧毁。

<... Did the voice just change? It wasn't just the audio quality this time, right?>
<这次好像不只是音质，连嗓音也发生了变化？>

... 'Tis the voice of that Sansón.
……与那名为参孙之人的嗓音颇为相似。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
And our dear Bloodfiend actors who have put so much effort into giving you a good surprise have all disappeared as well.
就连曾经为各位带来惊喜的各位血魔演员们也全都不复存在了。

... We have brought righteous judgment upon those evil wretches.
……那些恶徒已尽数惩戒。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Even the gentleman responsible for that narration...
甚至连担当旁白的那一位也……

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Well, perhaps in place of a photoshoot, we could slot in a brief explanation about the secrets of this kingdom.
看来比起拍照留念，还是关于这座王国的秘密解说更有必要。

The voice beyond the speaker began with a hint of excitement, as though he'd been expecting this situation all along. Or maybe he's expecting something to come of this.
音响另一端的声音仿佛早已预料到了当下的情况，又或是对着当今的场合抱有某种期待一般……以一种略为激昂的语调继续说道。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
... Long, Long ago, a lonesome king resided within the towering walls of this great castle.
……王曾在非常宽阔的城堡中独自度过了许久的岁月。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Enduring so many years in such a desolate place... wore him down.
而在空无一人的场所度日并非易事。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Lonely mornings, silent nights. The king's heart forever a hollow void.
冷清的朝阳与寂静的夜晚。王的内心每一天都充满了空虚。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
So, this soul-crushing loneliness drove the king to yearn for… a family.
所以，过于孤独的王开始追求家族。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Desperately. Oh, so desperately.
非常……非常恳切地追求。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
So, the king began turning his wish into reality. Forging a family of his own, blood-bound, to spend the rest of their lives together until the end of days.
所以，王开始如他所愿……创造与他共度此生，以血相连的家人。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The king's love for his family was bottomless and generous; soon, the cold, desolate castle became a cozy home brimming with warm laughter.
王为所有家人给予博爱。曾几何时的荒凉城堡顷刻间成为了大家欢声笑语的家园。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Yet, perhaps... happiness simply isn't a thing that lasts.
但幸福或许一向不怎么长存。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
It was on one of those many happy days when a knight, hailing from a faraway kingdom, arrived at the gates of this castle.
幸福存续的某一天，有一位出身遥远国度的骑士前来拜访。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The knight was a traveler and a wanderer with hundreds of adventures and thousands of tales to tell, collected from hither and thither and yonder beyond the world outside the castle.
骑士在城外四处旅行，历经数百场冒险，知晓数千个故事。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The king, who had spent his entire life never setting so much as a foot outside the castle, requested that the knight recount tales of those adventures to him.
终生在城内度日的王，请求骑士为他讲述自己的故事。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The knight, at want of any reason to refuse this request, said as such: "O honored king! Verily, I shall regale thee with tales of the worlds I've witnessed, the adventures I've undertaken!"
骑士没理由拒绝王的请求。骑士说道：“我所见证的世界，我所经历的冒险，都将言予君王！”

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Soon, something new, something different, began to fill the castle—tales of thrilling adventures. Some days, they would talk of a long voyage at sea, of heroes braving the relentless waves. Some days, they would whisper the heartbreaking, tragic tale of lovers. Some days, they would sing of a hero's perilous encounter with an unyielding monster... and it kept going, and going, and going, as though 'the end' was an idea alien to them.
城中很快就充满了令王心动不已的妙趣横生的冒险故事。一日是向着惊涛骇浪挺进的航海，一日是某人之间哀痛欲绝的凄凉爱情，又有一日是与骇人的怪兽殊死相搏……故事接二连三，滔滔不绝。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
As the king spent days upon days without sleep or rest, lost in the tales of adventures, he soon came to a grave realization.
接连数日昼夜不分废寝忘食倾听着骑士故事的王，终有一天领悟了某个极为重要的真相。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
That his family of blood... this confined happiness locked within the castle... cannot fill that void in his heart.
仅凭以血脉相连的家人……仅凭城中的幸福，还不足以完全填补自己那颗空虚的心。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
So, the king began to fill that emptiness with tales of adventures the knight regaled him with. And his infinite love for his family started to grow in a different direction. Toward adventure. Toward the knight. And toward the world outside the periphery of his castle.
所以王开始用骑士的冒险故事填补着内心的空缺。而原本仅属于家人的爱也开始向着冒险和骑士，以及城外蔓延。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The family thought it wouldn't last. It was all but a fleeting dream, after all—just a brief, silly whim in which he fancied himself as what he was not, donning himself a pair of ragged boots and wielding an iron lance.
家人们认为这种现象只是暂时的。觉得那不过是穿上破旧不堪的鞋子，提起铁制长枪的黄粱一梦。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The family waited. Waited for the king, their creator who not only gave them love... but bequeathed them the same void of the heart, to love them, and only them, again.
所以家人们等待着。等待着那将空虚感返还于己身的王，等待着那位创造者再次独爱着家族的时刻。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Yet, for all their waiting, what came thereafter from the king's mouth was bitter to their ears.
但是在等待的尽头，王的话语却让家人们苦不堪言。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
"Let us bring down the walls of this castle! Let us make friends with those outside!" declared the king.
“推倒这城墙，与城外的所有人成为朋友吧！”王如此呐喊道。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The family was afraid. To bring down the castle meant that their comfortable, familiar, and eternal home and nest was to be no more.
家族感到恐惧。因为摧毁城堡意味着将他们宁静永恒的家园化为废墟。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
But the family loved the lonely king and his will, enough to help him demolish his own castle. So the deed was done, spades in their hands.
但是出于对王的尊重，爱着王的家人们全都举起了铁铲，众志成城开始砸毁城堡。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Yet... those who lived outside the castle were far too different from those who lived within.
但是……由于围城之外的人们过着与城中人截然不同的生活。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
The king's family had to give up so many things.
王的家族不得不舍去诸多事物。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Happiness. Joy. Ecstasy. Pleasure. Hope. Anticipation...
喜悦、欢愉、惊叹、快乐、希望、期待……

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
They had to give them all up, because otherwise... they could not become friends with those outside the castle.
必须放弃这一切……他们才能成为朋友。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
So the king outlawed happiness from his family.
于是，王不再准许家族的幸福。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Because he believed that they could be happy merely by watching the happiness of others, of those who lived outside the castle, blossom. That happiness was something that could be shared. 
王相信仅仅依靠注视着城外幸福的人，家人们也可以分享其喜悦并一起变得幸福。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
Believing that their happiness could be our own, in time.
王相信，他们的幸福，终有一日也会成为我们的幸福。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
All of our pursuits of happiness... were deigned a sin.
于是乎我们为了幸福而作出的所有努力，尽数化为罪恶。

dataList.title:
La Manchaland
拉·曼却领
dataList.content:
So I ask: why must we repent for our happiness?
为什么我们要为自己的幸福而忏悔呢？

There were so many mentions of 'family'... What do you suppose he's trying to say?
家族……这究竟是想表达什么的故事呢？

A load of shit, that's what.
字里行间，全是胡言乱语。

How interesting. I wonder if that family ever had real happiness to begin with?
真是个有趣的故事。幸福真的存在于那个家族之中吗？

While everyone else found themselves rendered speechless by this gloomy tale, Hong Lu did not hesitate to share his thoughts as though it was just another lighthearted tale.
鸿璐仿佛无所谓一般毫无波澜地开了口，但由于这是个十分沉重的故事，所以大家都没能轻易接下话茬。

Ah, look; I see the exit sign over there. Looks like this is where the attraction ends?
啊，那里有出口的标志。看来这个游乐设施到此为止了呢。

<... Y-yeah. It says something under there...>
<……是、是啊。那边好像写着什么东西……>

There was a sign on the wall with instructions written in bolded letters.
墙上有着用粗体字写下的说明。

'All Bloodfiends must attend at least one weekly consultation session with the Priest.'
“所有血魔，每周必须与神父面谈一次。”

Consultation session...
面谈……

Consultations of what kind, and on which subject... One must wonder.
不知是关于何事的面谈……

Hmm... anything, I guess? Or maybe it's like... a confession?
说不定……什么都可以？就像……告解之类的？

Huh. I know it's clearly not true anymore, but...
不过，至少很久以前……

... La Manchaland must've put in a lot of effort back in the day.
拉·曼却领好像也发奋图强过啊……

Indeed. Perhaps... they once dreamed of coexistence.
或许，他们真的梦想着共生……

... Nay.
……非也。

Nothing but wicked trickery, all.
无稽之谈。均不过是狡诈的妖术而已。
